name: Samael
description:
'''Samael''' ({{IPAc-en|ˈ|s|æ|m|ə|ˌ|ɛ|l}}) is a Swiss [[heavy metal music|metal]] band formed in [[Sion, Switzerland|Sion]] in 1987. Their current lineup includes founding members and brothers [[Michael Locher|Vorphalack (Vorph)]] and Xytraguptor (Xy), guitarist Drop, and bassist Ales. Other members of the band throughout the years have been Rodolph H. (keyboards, 1993–1995), Kaos (guitar, 1996–2001), Mas (bass, 1991–2014) and Makro (guitar, 2002–2018). 

Samael mixes [[Heavy metal music|metal]], [[Industrial music|industrial]], [[Electronic music|electronic]] and [[symphonic music]] with massive beats, martial rhythms and up-tempo or [[blast beat]]. Samael uses a [[drum machine]] in the studio and live on stage.
